description: Header file defining the WebAudioClientBackend class, which implements the WebAudioClientBackendInterface for managing web audio playback functionalities in the Rialto client. It includes method declarations for creating, destroying, and controlling web audio playback, as well as querying buffer and device information.

classes.name: WebAudioClientBackend
classes.description: Final class implementing WebAudioClientBackendInterface, managing web audio playback and buffer operations.

methods.name: createWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Creates the web audio backend using a factory, initializing the m_webAudioPlayerBackend member.

methods.name: destroyWebAudioBackend
methods.description: Resets and destroys the web audio backend.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Starts playback of the web audio.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Sets the end of stream for the web audio.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves the available buffer frames and associated shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Gets the current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.
